items.question: 2017 年每个月的 GMV 是多少？
items.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS ym,
       ROUND(SUM(payment_value), 2) AS gmv,
       COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM order_metrics
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY ym
ORDER BY ym

items.question: 2017 年每个月的订单数是多少？

items.question: 收入最高的 10 个商品类目是哪些？
items.sql:
SELECT product_category,
       ROUND(SUM(price), 2) AS gmv,
       COUNT(*) AS item_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
FROM order_item_metrics
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  AND product_category IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY product_category
ORDER BY gmv DESC
LIMIT 10

items.question: 平均客单价最高的 10 个州是哪些？
items.sql:
SELECT customer_state,
       COUNT(*) AS order_cnt,
       ROUND(SUM(payment_value), 2) AS gmv,
       ROUND(AVG(payment_value), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM order_metrics
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  AND payment_value IS NOT NULL
  AND customer_state IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY customer_state
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC
LIMIT 10

items.question: 配送延迟最严重的 10 个州是哪些？
items.sql:
SELECT customer_state,
       COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders,
       ROUND(AVG(delivery_delay_days), 2) AS avg_delay_days,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN delivery_delay_days > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS late_rate_pct,
       SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_delay_days > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_orders,
       ROUND(AVG(delivery_days), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM order_metrics
WHERE delivery_days IS NOT NULL
  AND delivery_delay_days IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY customer_state
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
ORDER BY avg_delay_days DESC
LIMIT 10

items.question: 销量最高的 10 个商品是哪些？
items.sql:
SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS units, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders, ROUND(SUM(price), 2) AS gmv, MAX(product_category) AS category
FROM order_item_metrics
WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY units DESC
LIMIT 10

  SUM(CASE WHEN payment_value >= 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ge_200,
  SUM(CASE WHEN payment_value >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ge_500,

items.question: 评分低于 3 分的订单，平均配送延迟是多少天？
items.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_orders,
       ROUND(AVG(delivery_delay_days), 2) AS avg_delay_days,
       ROUND(MIN(delivery_delay_days), 2) AS min_delay,
       ROUND(MAX(delivery_delay_days), 2) AS max_delay,
       SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_delay_days > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_late,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_delay_days > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS late_rate_pct
FROM order_metrics
WHERE review_score IS NOT NULL
  AND review_score < 3
  AND delivery_days IS NOT NULL
  AND delivery_delay_days IS NOT NULL
